title: India's Current Account Deficit (CAD) Touches 1.3% of GDP in Q3 FY26
summary: RBI data shows Q3 FY26 CAD rose to $13.2 billion (1.3% of GDP), while Apr-Dec cumulative CAD moderated to $30.1 billion (1% of GDP).

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 India's Current Account Deficit (CAD) Touches 1.3% of GDP in Q3 FY26. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI reported Q3 FY2025-26 **CAD at $13.2 billion (1.3% of GDP)**, driven by a merchandise trade deficit of $93.6 billion, offset by net services receipts of $57.5 billion.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on CAD as % of GDP (1.3%), merchandise trade deficit figures, and invisibles/remittances surplus trajectory.
